shots.prompt:
On the timber-framed deck of the Alpine Rescue Station Deck, corrugated metal eaves shudder beneath antenna arrays and weather sensors, with cloud-filled valleys stretching below under crisp natural snow glare.

Elena Rostova, in her early 30s with an athletic compact build, olive skin, and dark brown hair in a tight crown braid, wears a red and yellow alpine rescue parka over black thermal trousers, a white climbing helmet with headlamp, and tinted glacier goggles around her neck. Beside her, stocky Tomas Lind, late 40s with weathered ruddy skin and thick grizzled grey hair, wears a heavy orange blizzard jacket, charcoal storm pants, grey knit beanie, and a black nylon climbing harness. Nearby sits the Rescue Toboggan, its clean yellow fiberglass hull empty with coiled tow ropes resting inside, while the Emergency Radio is clipped to Elena's left shoulder strap, powered on to channel seven. Elena taps her clipboard against the timber railing while Tomas checks his wristwatch as they review storm coordinates amid whistling gale gusts.

shots.prompt:
On the Alpine Rescue Station Deck, amber deck floodlights cast a protective glow against the cold, jagged peaks and dark valley mist.

Jake Miller, cocooned tightly within the reflective orange Thermal Bivy Capsule, rests between Elena Rostova in her red alpine fleece and Tomas Lind in his heavy orange blizzard jacket. Tomas gently hands Jake a steaming mug of hot broth while Elena rests a steady, supportive hand on Jake's shoulder, as distant ambulance sirens echo up from the valley below.

A slow pull-back shot frames the figures against the snowy mountain backdrop under station lights.
